# nostr.watch

> nostr.watch is a free, open-source monitor for Nostr relays. Monitors in several regions check relays every hour and publish the results as NIP-66 events. The same data is available on the website, as raw NIP-66 events on Nostr relays, over a REST API, and as MCP tools over Nostr (CVM).

The website (https://nostr.watch) is a client-side app: relay data loads in the browser over WebSockets. Agents that need data should use the REST API, the CVM/MCP tools, or raw NIP-66 events listed below instead of scraping the HTML.

## Data services

- [REST API v2](https://api.nostr.watch/v2/): OpenAPI documentation and live sandbox. Base URL `https://api.nostr.watch/v2`. Examples: `GET /relays?limit=10&sortBy=updated&sortOrder=desc`, `GET /relays/state?relayUrl=wss://relay.damus.io`, `POST /relays/search` with `{"nips":[42]}`, `GET /health/ping`. Response formats: `full`, `detailed` (default), `simple`.
- [CVM (MCP over Nostr)](https://cvm.nostr.watch): 21 MCP tools transported over Nostr, for AI agents and MCP clients. Tools include `relays/list`, `relays/state`, `relays/search`, `relays/nearby`, `relays/bbox`, `relays/by/software`, `relays/by/nip`, `relays/by/country`, `relays/online`, `relays/offline`, `relays/compare`, `monitors/list`, `monitors/get` and `relays/subscribe_state`.
- [NIP-66 specification](https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/66.md): the Nostr protocol for relay discovery and liveness monitoring. Kind 10166 is a monitor announcement, kind 30166 is a relay status (`d` tag = relay URL), and kind 1066 is a relay status delta.
- NIP-66 relays carrying monitor data: `wss://relay.nostr.watch`, `wss://relaypag.es`, `wss://monitorlizard.nostr1.com`.

## Website pages

- [Relays](https://nostr.watch/relays): sortable, filterable table of known relays with status, latency and supported NIPs.
- [Relay map](https://nostr.watch/relays/map): relays plotted by geolocation.
- [Relays by software](https://nostr.watch/relays/software): relay implementations and their counts.
- [Relays by country](https://nostr.watch/relays/geography): relays grouped by country.
- [Relays by ISP](https://nostr.watch/relays/isps): relays grouped by hosting provider.
- [Monitors](https://nostr.watch/monitors): NIP-66 monitors, their regions and check frequency.
- [Operators](https://nostr.watch/operators): relay operators.
- Relay detail: `https://nostr.watch/relays/wss/<host>` (for example https://nostr.watch/relays/wss/relay.damus.io), with NIP-11, checks, audits and insights tabs.

## About

- [Source code](https://github.com/sandwichfarm/nostr-watch): MIT-licensed monorepo (GUI, monitors, rstate aggregation engine, libraries).
- [sandwich.farm](https://sandwich.farm): the developer behind nostr.watch.
